label: Holder-root identification: laws, nonvacuity, necessary-through-another, omissions, two roots
paraphrase: Premise-free laws and finite models (structural surrogates, not metaphysical possibility). Laws: (1) with P2', P3' and holders at w, no holder is contingent at w, and with excluded middle every holder is concrete, exists at w and is NECESSARY_2 at w; (2) adding a common root of the selected relation, every holder is that root or a NECESSARY_2 actual concretum directly grounded by it; (3) with NAR, every holder is the common root. Models: theist nonvacuity of arguments 1-5; the necessary-through-another holder (a two-way giver satisfying the creator reading and factive giving; NAR fails; the common GOD_4 root with intellect and at most one root both hold; every holder conclusion fails); omissions of holders at w, P2' and P3'; two necessary underived holders (at most one root and the common root fail); a root holder beside a holder grounded by it (at most one root holds, at most one holder fails); omissions of at most one holder, the rational-power bridge, the GOD_4 bridge and the willed holder (the chance rival of #1941).
